text:
maya: Nightly eval alert: model-redwood-1 (INT8, calib=v2-per-tensor) shows huge quality drop on longform_news_v2 summarization set. avg ROUGE-L down ~18% vs float32. Pushed artifacts to CI: https://ci.internal/runs/1799990001 :grimacing:
ci-bot: nightly-eval: run 1799990001 completed, failure rate 21%, baseline-run 1799900000 had 2% on same suite. full diff: https://ci.internal/diffs/1799990001
dylan: when did we flip the calib profile? last night deploy notes?
maya: deployed new calibration profile at 02:05 UTC (auto rollout). config change: `quant_profiles/default -> v2-per-tensor-scale`
sophie: can you paste a concrete example of the failure? short is fine.
maya: here — prompt:
```
Input: "Write a concise summary (~3 sentences) of this article: [long 1200-word news article about supply chain delays]."
```
Float32 output (good):
"Supply chain delays persist due to port congestion and labor shortages. Shippers are diverting shipments and firms are increasing buffer inventories. Outlook suggests gradual easing by Q3 as capacity normalizes."
INT8 output (bad):
"The mayor declared the shipment illegal. The police arrested several trucks. Citizens complained about the smell."
(keeps hallucinating entities, unrelated facts)
arjun: that divergence smells like calibration/KV cache corruption rather than prompt handling. Does it kick in after certain token index?
maya: looking at token-level logs — divergence starts around generation step 126 (long context). attaching trimmed logits dump.
```
Step 120 logits/topk distribution looks fine
Step 126 tokens jump to weird high-confidence tokens not in beam
```
dylan: can you repro locally with the same quantization artifacts? run `./scripts/repro_quant.sh --model redwood-1 --calib v2-per-tensor --seed 42 --input examples/long_news_13.txt`
arjun: I'll run that on a dev GPU. also run with `--kv-debug` to track cache differences.
arjun: (10m later) repro'd. quick diff shows attention key/value tensors after quantize have small sign flips at 4th decimal that cause accumulation over many steps. suspect per-tensor scale loses head-level dynamics for very long contexts.
sophie: can you try rolling back to previous calib profile and re-run nightly? that should confirm if calib is root cause.
maya: rolled back to `v1-channelwise` at 03:12 UTC and re-ran the suite on a subset. preliminary: ROUGE-L back within 1% of float32. pushing full rerun to CI now: https://ci.internal/runs/1799990120
ci-bot: rerun 1799990120 queued, subset quick-run passed baseline thresholds.
dylan: good. action items: 1) arjun to dig into per-tensor-vs-channelwise quant stats and propose mitigation (per-head scaling?) 2) sophie to add a long-context regression test to nightly evals that exercises >12k tokens for summarization 3) maya to document the rollback and signal to infra for cautious rollout gating.
arjun: filing issue: https://issues.internal/RED-3124 "INT8 per-tensor calib causes long-context KV drift" assigned to @arjun, adding repro logs and sample prompts. ETA EOW for first pass.
sophie: I'll add a regression check and a smoke test (short) plus a full long-run nightly-only test. PR coming.
maya: thanks all. we should also flag customer-impact channels if anyone saw anomalies in production traces. cc @support. :eyes: :rotating_light:
dylan: can we add sanity thresholds in eval that fail rollouts if delta>5% on key prompt sets? paging product for gating policy next sprint.
ci-bot: note: artifacts archived at https://ci.internal/artifacts/1799990001.tar.gz
maya: attaching the single worst example and the two outputs to the issue. closing triage for now, followups in RED-3124 and the upcoming PRs. :white_check_mark:
